w: While Swamishri was doing darshan of the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj in the mandir shrine, a sadhu said, "Today, Laxmiji has been adorned with a yellow chandlo, however Dr. Swami said there should be a red chandlo instead." Swamishri replied, "Yes, that's right. Because the murti of Narayan has a red chandlo." The sadhu sweetly argued, "Because Laxmiji is adorned in a yellow sari then the color of the chandlo should match with it! Like the color of the sari, so too should the chandlo be." Swamishri tellingly replied, "Should it be matched with Narayan or the sari?" Swamishri is a great proponent of tradition and faith. The chandlo (on a married woman) is a mark of privilege and auspiciousness symbolizing that she has a master, a husband. And there is also an emphasis in Swamishri's words that one should match with God and not with mundane fashions and things.
The simpler the lifestyle and lesser the needs, the more the peace of mind.
Sometimes we accomplish and decorate ourselves outwardly, but if we have not internalized its true spirit then we fail in life.
Always see the virtues of all. If you look for faults then you will see faults. We have not come (in Satsang) for that.
Spirituality is our real asset. It needs to be lived in life.
Both the society and the individual experience peace when one renounces 'I'ness and 'My'ness and offers service to society.
At 10.45 a.m. Lt. Governor of New Delhi Shri Vijay Kapoor met Swamishri. He praised the Akshardham construction work.

Then Swamishri visited the main Akshardham Monument work and performed pujan, arti and pushpanjali of a 'key' (ornately carved part of ceiling). Thereafter Swamishri blessed, saying, "The monument will be completed and become a wonder. Hundreds of thousands of people will come here. The monument was the wish of Yogiji Maharaj. We pray to Maharaj that He redeems all those who come here. And may it (Akshardham) remain as it is for darshan till the earth's existence..."

At 9.30 am Swamishri, and renowned pundits K.K. Shastri and Dr Devkinandan Dwivedi lit the divas to inaugurate the Golden Anniversary Convention of the Akhil Bharatiya Darshan Parishad arranged at the Pramukh Swami Auditorium in the mandir complex. More than 300 philosophers from all parts of India had congregated for the convention.

During the inaugural session of the conference, renowned pundits, namely, Siddheshwar Bhatt, S.R. Vyas, Ramjisinh, S.K. Sheth, D.R. Bhandari, Devkinandan Dwivedi, Jyotiswarup Dubey and others honoured Swamishri and received his blessings. Thereafter Dr. Siddheshwar Bhatt and S.R. Vyas and others addressed the convention.

Swamishri honoured K.K. Shastri, a centurion and renowned pundit on Vaishnavism in Gujarat, by presenting a golden kalash and shawl. Swamishri blessed K.K. Shastri saying, “No matter how much we honour you it is less. You have internalised the Vaishnav principles in your life.” Thereafter K.K. Shastri addressed the convention, “I am indeed blessed to have been honoured by Pramukh Swami Maharaj in my centennial year. My family was blessed by Shastriji Maharaj. Yogiji Maharaj, too, showered his grace upon me and Pramukh Swami Maharaj has blessed me personally.” Then Dr. Devkinandan Dwivedi presented his keynote address. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “It brings me great joy to welcome all of you here today who have come to discuss and enlighten your selves about philosophy and dharma. The Shrimad Bhagvad Gita has proclaimed that whenever there is an ebb in dharma God descends on earth. The Gita also mentions the presence of good and evil elements. The evil elements cause pain, destruction and misery. Whereas peace is got through good elements…” Then Swamishri succinctly narrated the life and work of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. In the evening satsang assembly at 7.00 pm Swamishri honoured the renowned pundits, Shri S.K. Dubey and Ramjisinh. After their brief address Swamishri blessed the assembly in Hindi laced with Gujarati.

Dr Subramaniam, who had performed Swamishri’s bypass surgery, met Swamishri after seeing Akshardham. He said, “I felt very happy on seeing Akshardham. After entering it I experienced peace.” “Now Swami, what is your next project?,” Dr Subramaniam enquired. To inspire satsang, do bhajan and to inspire good feelings in all. Our project is to spread peace in the world and to increase bhakti in ongoing.”

Like every year an annakut was offered to Thakorji in all three shrines of the mandir on Dev Diwali. The Kartik Punam assembly commenced at 8.00 am on the grounds of Akshar-Purushottam Vidyalay: Viveksagar Swami spoke on Swamishri’s vicharan abroad. Children and youths of Adas mandal performed a cultural dance. Dr Swami spoke on how to become an ideal devotee. Ishwarcharan Swami gave highlights of the BAPS Centenary Celebrations to be held in Ahmedabad and invited all to attend.

26 November 2007 , (V.S. 2063-64, vad 2 ) Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Shri Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Hanumanji, Shri Ganapatiji and Guru Parampara for the BAPS hari mandir in Ratanpura.
